description: 1 free call per caller, then $0.0015 USDC via x402 (paid in-band: params._meta["x402/payment"]). QR code generator: text, URL, payment URI (e.g. ethereum:/USDC request) or Wi-Fi credentials (ssid + password) to a QR code as SVG (inline + data URI) and/or GIF data URI. Error correction L/M/Q/H, scale, quiet-zone margin, colours, optional 0/1 module matrix. UTF-8 byte mode, computed locally, nothing stored. When to use: Use qr-code to turn a URL, payment request, Wi-Fi login or any text into a scannable QR image (SVG or GIF data URI).
